components.name: hdr
components.description: HDR10 output on the virtual display (ENABLE_HDR). Needs hermes_kms with hdr_enable=Y. 'auto' leaves ENABLE_HDR untouched, so the module's own capability decides.

components.name: steam-gamescope
components.description: Run the Steam session inside gamescope (STEAM_GAMESCOPE). 'off' is the compatible path: Steam runs directly on the sway session.
